title: Econ Orbit: rotational guild + experiment sprint tracker for batching, caching, quantization
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Charter: Stand up a recurring cross-functional guild (Econ Orbit) that rotates engineering 'savings champions' through focused 2-week experiment sprints. Each sprint runs 3 controlled experiments spanning batching, KV/prefix caching, and model quantization profiles. Goal: establish a repeatable hypothesis->experiment->rollout pipeline that reliably produces safe unit-cost reductions while preserving latency SLOs and output quality. Success metrics: >=10% median token-cost reduction for targeted workload cohort OR <=5% 95th-percentile latency regression vs baseline; at least one rolloutable change per sprint that passes quality gates.
acceptance_criteria: Guild roster and rotation calendar published for Q2 2025
Experiment template (hypothesis, measurement plan, rollback, QA) stored in Confluence
Three parallel experiments executed end-to-end in pilot sprint with documented outcomes
Dashboard shows cost and latency comparisons for experiment cohorts and baseline
At least one change cleared for staged rollout with rollback playbook and cost impact estimate
updates: 2025-02-12 Ava Martinez: Created charter and initial sprint plan. Proposed guild cadence: 2-week sprints, 1 rotation per quarter for each eng squad. Linked experiment template and measurement runbook.

2025-02-18 Rahul Singh: Confirmed funding window with finance; set target cost reduction hypothesis at 8-12% for inference-heavy clients. Requested dedicated ENG time for scheduling kernels and batching improvements.

2025-02-24 Lucas Chen (ENG): POC for adaptive batching landed. PR linked; early microbenchmarks show 6% cost drop for short-seq workloads but increases tail latency by ~2%. Added action item: tune batch size thresholds and fallback policy.
2025-02-27 Design review (Maya Patel): Reviewed rollout UX requirements for console flags and rollout toggles; requested clearer OK/rollback indicators and per-route cost forecasts.

2025-03-01 QA (Sofia Alvarez): Drafted quality validation checklist for quantization experiments including sample fidelity tests and failing-case capture. Recommended synthetic prompt set for regression checks.

2025-03-04 Rahul Singh: Sprint 01 retrospective planned for 2025-03-06. Preliminary status: 3 experiments executed (adaptive batching, prefix-KV TTL tuning, int8 quantization profile). Adaptive batching is a candidate for staged rollout pending latency tuning; KV TTL tuning reduced token cost by 4% with no quality regression; int8 quantization needs expanded evals for safety on long-form outputs. Next steps: schedule kernel tuning with infra team and prepare rollout runbook for batching candidate.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Latency regressions for 95th-percentile users when increasing batch sizes. Mitigation: staged rollout with traffic shadowing and dynamic fallback to low-latency profile.
Risk: Quantization introduces hallucination drift on long prompts. Mitigation: expanded regression set + automated fail-fast checks; require manual sign-off from Applied ML before rollout.
Risk: Cross-team bandwidth mismatch during rotation weeks. Mitigation: publish rotation calendar 6 weeks ahead and reserve 20% engineer capacity for guild weeks in sprint planning.
